blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano could only wish Sen. Mark Villar well as the latter left the minority to join the Senate majority. “As we continue to pray for our country, we wish Senator Mark Villar and all our colleagues well,” Cayetano said in a statement posted on Facebook on Thursday. “May GOD grant us all the wisdom, humility, and strength to faithfully serve HIM and the Filipino people,” he added. Villar’s move to cross over to the majority was confirmed after he was elected chair of the Senate committee on public works, replacing Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente […]...
